newsitem.title: UK: Dlr settles off highs in Europe after brief lift.
newsitem.headline: Dlr settles off highs in Europe after brief lift.

text.p: The dollar motored back to 34-month highs after a hefty rise in U.S non-farm payrolls and a fall in the jobless rate, but settled off peaks in Europe as the figures failed to convince the market of an imminent rate hike.

"The employment numbers are pretty good...On the other hand, they are not strong enough to give the market a view the Fed will be definitely be tightening rates," said Tony Norfield, treasury economist at ABN AMR0.
At 1434 the dollar stood at 1.7168/80 marks after spiking briefly to session peaks of 1.7210 marks, also a 34-month high.
